title: Production's screening opens only for the deployed tag's binding capacity report, measured and attested by its release, that passes (decision 13)
assertion: The CDK app computes the launch value at synthesis from the report and the attestation bundle the deploy names, with the launch check, only for the tag's binding report that release.yml measured on the tag and attested in that run (GitHub's artifact attestation, verified by gh attestation verify against the bundle as signed by this repository's release.yml at refs/tags/<tag>, at the tag's commit, on a GitHub-hosted runner, then read again field by field: the report's SHA-256, the signer, the ref, the commit, the runner, the event and the run the report records; the report's recorded GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF the tag's release.yml, its run and attempt named in the note; a report measured anywhere else, attested by another workflow, ref or repository, or edited after it was signed, refused, naming why) from the Docker runtime that passes with time enforced, as recorded and as read again in binding mode (every scenario but S4's three runs judged on time whatever repetition it records; an advisory report, a pull request's, refused whatever its verdict, the mode named), measured at the tag's commit, on both images by config digest as ECR holds them for the stack's repositories (each manifest read from the registry, an index resolved to its linux/amd64 manifest, nothing pulled, whatever the deployer's image store; a registry not read, a platform manifest not found, no linux/amd64 manifest or an unexpected media type named) and with every size production declares (the web, the platform, each consumer task and their number, Postgres, the storage and the consumer's concurrency), on the layout the release's runner gives, the free 4-CPU runner's shared CPUs (CPUs of their own refused until a release measures on 8 CPUs); anything else stops the synthesis, naming decision 13 and each reason; no report keeps the screening closed; a value set by hand is refused (context of any spelling, and no ScreeningLaunch parameter is declared); a rule refuses a deploy whose image tag is not the report's; the consumer runs whenever a launch value is set, so no deploy opens the screening without it; the web keeps production closed unless the value names the image tag it runs; staging and development are not gated
noFileReason: The launch check reads synthetic capacity reports and synthetic attestation verifications (gh’s JSON) built in memory; no file.
